concreteCompatibilityPitfalls: Support observation tests mock logger or inject sink: existing tests do not prove real Pino serialization retains accepted observation schema. Real-Pino composed memory-sink tests are necessary.
Global remove-all-fields filters could destroy Support tenant_key/artifact_sha matching and unsampled coverage. Preserve exact known schema, do not turn invalid/missing evidence into success/zero.

ERP provider uses dynamic org/invoice strings in six generic warnings; social finalizer builds a regex-admitted error-derived code and raw IDs in context. Their business result/skip/retry behavior must remain while log content becomes finite.
A Pino logMethod hook alone can miss child bindings, mixins, serialization or later interpolated arguments. Do not expose an unsanitized child/logger route as proof of full boundary protection.
Object spread, Object.entries, JSON.stringify or regex coercion can invoke getters/toJSON. Input projection must avoid unknown accessor evaluation and contain policy/destination exceptions.

RLS test guard marker is asserted by existing lib-prisma-rls-extension tests; eliminating the throw or issuing the query would weaken safety. Stack removal does not justify altering query/transaction order.
Current logAudit documentation mentions awaited security writes but implementation catches and resolves; fixing this semantic discrepancy is outside the privacy slice.
Browser replayOnErrorSampleRate1.0 and replayIntegration exist independently of six event hooks. maskAllText/blockAllMedia are not proof for URL/network/context privacy.
next.config Sentry sourcemap upload is a separate build destination. Do not change credentials/organization/project or claim retention/access verified from repository configuration.
meaningfulProofCases: Actual withRls/withRlsAuth/withRlsSessionAuth with Error/private-name/stack/cause, string, null, opaque getters: fixedsink, same401, no handler calls; auth deny and successful tenant path unchanged.

Actual Prisma logAudit with rejected create: same insert payload/context and resolved return, fixed fallback; logging sink throws without changing audit outcome. RLS no-context test throws before query; prod warns once; context/batch/interactive transaction ordering unaffected.

Actual Support observeSupportUxOperation -> actual logger -> real Pino memory destination: every schema key/value preserved, exactly one event, unchanged Response/thrown identity; no raw synthetic values. Route observability equivalent composed projection.

Pino all supported invocation forms including child bindings, Error objects, formatting placeholders, nestedunknown/eventspoof/toJSON/getters/cycles and destination exceptions. Test final serialized bytes, not only sanitizer return values.

Actual three Sentry config modules with inert SDK init and synthetic event/transaction inputs: request, user, exception, breadcrumb, spans, tags and hostile object canaries absent; approved metadata retained; original input unmodified if projection contract promises immutability.
Explicit Replay configuration/transport case, separate from event hook tests; route transitions and global crash page remain functional. Existing demo-center token redaction regression must continue.
Source contract enumerates supported sinks and unknown-field fallback; no real network/DSN/collector or external configuration needed for these synthetic proofs.

scopeDecision: User authorization now permits a concrete shared-privacy slice. No same-file competing writer or separate permission blocker is established by this review. Preserve known Support operations and test contracts; external destination claims remain blocked without their separately authorized evidence. Existing source probes are a regression baseline, not new production findings.
